diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~31% of its level). There is little seasonal structure. The series is quite predictable: its energy concentrates in a few structured frequencies. The series reads as ambiguous by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (279 points, ~2% of the sample). The series crosses zero, so percentage errors are unstable and mean-based combinations are safer than ratio-based ones. Across validation windows the model ranking is stable (Kendall tau 0.797), which favours a selective combination.

Test a per-horizon selective weighting using softmax_neg_error to see if it improves over trimmed mean in this trend-dominated, stable ranking series.
The series is trend-dominated with stable rankings; a simple mean may capture the trend while being robust to correlated errors.
The series is trend-dominated with high predictability and stable ranking; a simple robust central tendency like median may beat trimmed mean.
The series is trend-dominated with stable ranking; a selective DBA might improve over median by focusing on top models.
test a per‑horizon selective weighting (best_per_horizon) to see if different models win at different lags in this trend‑dominated series.
The series is trend‑dominated with high predictability and stable ranking; a selective weighted combo on the top‑5 models (pool4) may outperform median.
Try a simple mean on the selective pool4 to see if removing weights improves robustness for this trend-dominated series.
try a per-horizon selective weighting on the selective pool4 to see if a best-per-horizon (one-hot) approach improves over the softmax on the same pool.
Test a per‑horizon weighted mean from the top‑k per‑horizon handle (w5) on the selective pool4 to see if horizon‑specific averaging improves over static weighting.
try a weighted combination on the selective pool4 using inverse_error weights to see if simple inverse error improves over softmax/horizon weights.

decision.justification: Selected 'weighted on pool4 weighted by w5' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.0521. Series context: trend strength 0.8831 and seasonal strength 0.2489; model ranking is stable across windows (Kendall tau 0.797); 3 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 43358248136.428.
